prayer: PRAYER:— Criminal Original Petition filed under Section 482 of CrPC, to direct the respondent to comply with the orders of the learned District Munsif cum Judicial Magistrate, Srirangam dated 31-3-2022 in Crl.M.P. No. 960 of 2022 by registering the first information report against the accused persons.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

P. Dhanabal, J.:— The Court made the following order:

When the matter is taken up for hearing today, the learned government advocate (Crl. Side) would submit that already order of the Court has been complied with and the first information report has been registered in Crime No. 147 of 2026, hence no further order is required to be passed in this petition.

2. In view of the same, the petition stands closed.
